install.title: System Installation
install.token.tip: The install token is printed in the backend startup log (install token). Restarting the backend regenerates it and prints it again.
install.token.file: If the startup log is not visible, open this file on the server to read the token (deleted automatically once installation completes):
install.port.tip: Leave empty for the default port (80/443)
install.recap.tip: Settings saved so far; they can be changed in the console after installation
install.theme.source.bundled.tip: Use the default theme bundled with the system
install.theme.library.placeholder: Select a theme package from the library
install.theme.marketplace.placeholder: Marketplace item ID, e.g. corporate or corporate{'@'}1.2.0
install.theme.upload.placeholder: Click or drag to select a theme package ZIP
install.theme.upload.tip: The theme package ZIP is first registered in the theme package library, then installed from the library copy (the package manifest must declare themeName)
install.theme.ref.required: Select or enter a theme reference
install.seedScope.all.tip: Import the current theme's demo channels, articles and page composition to get a complete demo site
install.seedScope.none.tip: Skip the demo data import and get an empty site (advanced)
install.theme.running: Importing demo data and finishing the installation, please wait...
install.completed.tip: The system is installed and the install channel is now closed.
install.seed.skipped: No demo data was imported; the site is empty.
install.notReady: System core is not ready: the bootstrap data script has not run or failed. Check the backend startup log
